preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the sequence for each test case is between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 3 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of integers across all test cases does not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.expression: For each test case, output n distinct integers a_1, a_2, ..., a_n such that 1 <= a_i <= 10^9 for all i.
postconditions.description: The output sequence must contain n distinct integers within the range [1, 10^9].

postconditions.expression: The difference between the maximum and minimum values in the sequence equals the square root of the sum of the sequence.
postconditions.description: The difference between the maximum and minimum values in the sequence must be equal to the square root of the sum of all elements in the sequence.
